goal: Define and check the pipeline gate: the checks a CI pipeline must pass before a merge, with each rule and its…
use: Define and check the pipeline gate: the checks a CI pipeline must pass before a merge, with each rule and its owner written out. Use when a team sets up or changes CI checks.

steps.note: Read the pipeline. Open the CI configuration and list every job, its trigger, and which ones block the merge.
List the required checks. Build, test, lint, static analysis and dependency checks should all be required.
Check the bypasses. Flag steps marked allowed-to-fail, skipped branches and manual overrides with no recorded owner.
Check the timing. Slow gates get skipped.
Check the records. Each run should keep its result, commit and tool version.
Report. A table of gates: check, blocking or not, owner, and the gap found.

protocol.title: Read the pipeline
protocol.text: Open the CI configuration and list every job, its trigger, and which ones block the merge.

protocol.title: List the required checks
protocol.text: Build, test, lint, static analysis and dependency checks should all be required. Flag any that are optional.

protocol.title: Check the bypasses
protocol.text: Flag steps marked allowed-to-fail, skipped branches and manual overrides with no recorded owner.

protocol.title: Check the timing
protocol.text: Slow gates get skipped. Note the run time of each job and the order they run in.

protocol.title: Check the records
protocol.text: Each run should keep its result, commit and tool version.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A table of gates: check, blocking or not, owner, and the gap found.
